sentiment: A river returns to itself one slow dam at a time; whole small worlds end quietly — both go unannounced.

stories.title: Artificial beaver dams saw juvenile coho salmon survival rates go from 8% to 60%
stories.summary: Low hand-built dams of woven willow and mud are quietly coaxing California creeks back to life — juvenile coho survival rising from 8% to 60% because someone built something that merely looks like what the river already knew.

stories.title: GPS glitched across the US by as much as 33 feet
stories.summary: For a while the whole country's navigation drifted by up to 33 feet and almost no one noticed — a quiet reminder of how much of the sky we trust without ever looking at it.

stories.title: .name Termination
stories.summary: A small old corner of the internet, .name, is being retired — an ending with no fanfare, just the quiet sunsetting of addresses that meant something to someone.
